component.name: Herbarium
component.summary: A library for the HTML pages AI tools make

description.p: Herbarium is a quiet home for the HTML explainers, cheat sheets and tiny interactive tools that AI makes. Save a page from the browser, a chat export or a file, read it offline with its interactivity intact, highlight it, and let adaptive review bring it back right before you would forget it.

Pages stay plain .html files in a folder you own, with a small JSON sidecar for titles, tags, notes and review dates. Every page runs in a sandbox that cannot reach your files, the app or other pages; network access is a per-page switch.

Today is a dashboard with a review ring, a garden of page vitality and a grove of reading paths. Paths grow a tree as you read them, review sessions end with a summary and a streak, and ten type styles change the app's voice. There is also a link graph, full-text search with filters, AI remix and organizing, a command palette, light and dark themes, and an English and French interface.

description.p: Reading paths now grow trees, with a flat-shaded 3D hero where WebGL is available. Today is a dashboard with a review ring, a garden of page vitality and a grove of every path. Review sessions get a progress bar, a timer, grade buttons that show the interval they would schedule, and a summary with the pages recovered and your streak. Ten type styles and four text sizes change the app's voice, and motion, illustrations and celebrations make the library feel alive.
Pages now keep their own state across reloads, in-app edits have a version history with a diff view, an `herbarium add` CLI and herbarium-app:// deep links, and review scheduling is adaptive.
